name: registry
description: Docker Registry (registry:2 / distribution): blob storage is content-addressed files - a live copy is safe (uploads in progress appear as incomplete _uploads and are ignored by the registry). No database. Consider 'registry garbage-collect' before big backups to shrink orphaned blobs. NOTE: template auto-detection matches the image token 'registry:' - if this hint fires on an unrelated stack that pulls from a host literally named 'registry:<port>', just ignore it.
